//: JSON has no comments, so these notes live in this top-level '//' key (npm ignores it).
dependencies: packages your app needs at runtime, also in production.
dotenv: loads DB credentials etc. from a .env file into process.env.
express: the web server framework (routes, middleware).
pg: the PostgreSQL driver that TypeORM uses underneath.
reflect-metadata: required by TypeORM decorators (@Entity, @Column) to read type info.
typeorm: the ORM, maps your entities/classes to Postgres tables.
devDependencies: tools needed only while developing/building, not at runtime.
@types/express: TypeScript types for Request, Response, NextFunction.
@types/node: TypeScript types for Node globals like process and console.
typescript: the compiler that turns .ts into .js (also provides the tsc command).
dev: runs src/app.ts with tsx and restarts on every save (needs 'npm i -D tsx').
build: compiles the project to JavaScript using tsconfig.json.
start (not added yet): would run the built JS, e.g. 'node dist/app.js'.
